subject: Marot kickoff — one eval console for human + automated MT quality
body:
Hi both,

Kicking off the Marot workstream. The goal: make our open-source Marot app the standard console every language team uses to analyze MQM human-eval data, side by side with automated metrics like BLEURT. Today teams pass around spreadsheets; the app already computes per-segment MQM scores by averaging rater scores with severity/category weights, so the win is integration, not invention.

Milestones (window through 07-20):
- 04-17: internal hosted deployment (no more downloading marot.html by hand), self-serve file upload preserved.
- 05-22: Evalline integration so BLEURT columns land automatically next to MQM.
- 07-13: adoption target — 3 language teams using it for their weekly QA reviews.

Deshawn owns staffing and the hosting plan; Freya is tech lead. Resource asks to me by end of next week please.

Lucia
